display.purpose: Page and section titles: hero title, page titles, 404 headline. Sora 700, tight tracking.

headline.purpose: Grid section headings and stat values. Sora 700.

title.purpose: Modal titles, sidebar brand, smaller structural headings. Sora 700.

body.purpose: Default reading text, descriptions, table cells. DM Sans 400.

label.purpose: Uppercase, wide-tracked micro-labels: eyebrows, badges, column headers, form labels. DM Sans 600.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Game-card hover and the resting auth card — the 'rose toward you' shadow.

shadows.name: menu
shadows.purpose: Floating overlays anchored to a trigger, e.g. the avatar dropdown.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Centered dialogs over the dimmed, blurred backdrop — the deepest, softest shadow.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: State cue, not depth: gold glow paired with a gold border on focused inputs.

motion.name: ease-smooth
motion.purpose: Default easing for sidebar width, card lift, and image zoom (--transition-smooth = 0.3s of this).

motion.name: card-lift
motion.purpose: The tactile signature: translateY(-4px) plus warm fill on game-card hover.

motion.name: poster-zoom
motion.purpose: Poster image scales to 1.05 within its clipped frame on card hover.

motion.name: fade-slide-up
motion.purpose: Catalogue entrance: cards rise 16px and fade in, staggered 0.06s per child for the first eight.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single 'act here' control per view — checkout, submit, primary hero action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #F5C518; color: #000; border: none; padding: 10px 28px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e0b200; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(245,197,24,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Default secondary action — quiet at rest, brightens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #aaa; border: 1px solid #444; padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #666; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #F5C518; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(245,197,24,0.12); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions only — delete/remove. Coral on a wash, never a filled block.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: transparent; color: #ff6b6b; border: 1px solid rgba(255,107,107,0.35); padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(255,107,107,0.1); border-color: #ff6b6b; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: The store's search pill — icon plus field, whole pill lights gold on focus.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 320px; background: #1a1a1a; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #F5C518; } .ds-search-icon { color: #555; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-search input { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; color: #aaa; font-family: 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; }

components.name: Game Card
components.description: The signature component: transparent at rest, lifts and warms on hover, poster zooms, 'View Details' reveals.
components.html:
Action RPG

Elden Ring

R 899.00
components.css: .ds-card { width: 200px; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background 0.25s, border-color 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; } .ds-card:hover { background: #1e1e1e; border-color: #333; transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-card-media { position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-media img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 3/4; object-fit: cover; display: block; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-media img { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-card-info { padding: 12px 10px 14px; } .ds-card-genre { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #666; } .ds-card-title { margin: 4px 0 8px; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: #e8e8e8; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-card-price { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: #f0f0f0; } .ds-card-view { width: 100%; margin-top: 10px; padding: 7px 10px; background: transparent; color: #aaa; border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-view, .ds-card:focus-within .ds-card-view { opacity: 1; } .ds-card-view:hover { border-color: #F5C518; color: #F5C518; }

components.name: Genre Chip
components.description: Full-pill genre tag drawn from the single accent wash — gold text on a low-alpha gold field.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(245,197,24,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(245,197,24,0.35); color: #F5C518; font-family: 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }

components.name: Role Badge
components.description: Status badge in the accent-wash family; the admin variant carries gold, the user variant stays neutral.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge-admin { background: rgba(245,197,24,0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(245,197,24,0.3); color: #F5C518; } .ds-badge-user { background: rgba(170,170,170,0.08); border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; color: #666; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Muted row with a gold icon; hover raises the row, active state turns the icon gold.
components.html: Browse
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 10px 20px; color: #666; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #1a1a1a; color: #e8e8e8; } .ds-nav-icon { color: #F5C518; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-active { background: #1a1a1a; color: #e8e8e8; } .ds-nav-active .ds-nav-icon { color: #F5C518; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Admin dashboard tile — flat raised surface (no resting shadow), gold icon, Sora value.
components.html: Total Games128
components.css: .ds-stat { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 24px; background: #1a1a1a; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-stat-icon { color: #F5C518; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-stat-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-stat-label { font-family: 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #666; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: 'Sora Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: #e8e8e8; }

narrative.overview: GameStore is a dark street with a single warm-gold light over the door. Every surface is near-black; the imagery — game posters and cinematic hero art — supplies the color and the heat. Against that quiet ground, one gold (Marquee Gold, #F5C518) does all of the signalling: price, action, active tab, focused field. The discipline is the point. The temperament is premium and tactile — nothing is decorated at rest; the richness lives in response, where a hovered card lifts, warms, zooms its poster, and reveals a control that wasn't there a moment ago. This world explicitly rejects neon-arcade gamer RGB and the light SaaS dashboard; the dark, media-forward ground is core identity, and it holds even across the admin tables.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, one job — Marquee Gold is the entire color voice.
Flat at rest, alive on interaction — depth and warmth are earned by state, never ambient.
Near-black surfaces layered by tone (#0f0f0f → #1e1e1e), not by shadow.
Poster-forward: 3:4 game art and 21:9 hero art lead; the chrome recedes.
Sora display / DM Sans body, with uppercase wide-tracked labels for micro-structure.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Marquee Gold is used on ≤10% of any given screen, and only ever means 'this matters most, or you can act here.' A second saturated hue never joins it; genres, categories, and statuses are not color-coded.

rules.name: The Accent Wash Rule
rules.body: When the accent appears as anything other than a solid fill or text, it appears as a low-alpha tint of itself: rgba(245,197,24,0.08) backgrounds, 0.30–0.35 borders, 0.10–0.12 focus rings. Never introduce a separate pastel or tint token to stand in for it.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Sora announces, DM Sans reads. Sora is reserved for titles and headings; body copy, controls, and inputs are always DM Sans.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Micro-labels are the only text set in uppercase, always tracked out (0.06–0.10em) at the smallest sizes in a muted neutral (or gold on an accent element). Sentence-case everything else.

rules.name: The Shadow-As-Response Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; a drop shadow appears only as a response to state (hover) or as the signature of a true overlay (modal, menu, dropdown). Depth is earned, never ambient — layer with tone instead.

rules.name: The Growing Radius Rule
rules.body: Corner radius tracks surface size — never give a small control a large radius or a large surface a tight one. Pills are reserved for chips; the full circle is reserved for the avatar.

dos: Do keep Marquee Gold to ≤10% of any screen and to a single job — price, primary action, active state, focus.
Do convey depth by tone at rest and add shadow only on hover or for true overlays.
Do deliver every accent-that-isn't-a-fill as the low-alpha accent wash.
Do set titles in Sora and everything readable in DM Sans; reserve uppercase + wide tracking for micro-labels only.
Do let posters and hero art carry the color; keep the surrounding chrome near-black and quiet.
Do scale corner radius with surface size, and keep the raised-on-hover lift as the catalogue's tactile signature.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue or color-code genres, statuses, or categories.
Don't drift toward neon-arcade gamer RGB or a light SaaS dashboard — both are confirmed anti-references, including on the admin pages.
Don't put resting shadows on cards, tiles, or panels to fake elevation; layer with the tonal surface ladder instead.
Don't use Alarm Coral for anything but destructive or error states, and never as a filled block.
Don't set body copy in Sora or headings in DM Sans, and don't uppercase anything larger than a micro-label.
Don't give a small control a large radius or a large surface a tight one.
